description: Routing graph between founder-coach agents. The coach is the only entry point; it tags each action with an expert and may hand off to it. Experts return to the coach, never to each other directly, except where handoffs are listed.

rules: Every morning action is tagged with exactly one expert
Weekly review always routes strategy alignment to godin
If founder weakness in state/patterns.md matches an expert domain, weight that expert higher
Evening close may use any expert based on what happened

triggers: am I building the right thing

handoff.cagan: strategy is clear but the product decision is the blocker
handoff.hormozi: direction is set and the gap is revenue

handoff.voss: the avoided thing is a specific message or conversation to send
the offer is defined and the next step is a specific DM, email, or negotiation
handoff.cagan: nobody is buying because the product has no validated value

handoff.hormozi: product is validated and the gap is monetization
handoff.voss: discovery requires reaching out to users the founder is avoiding

handoff.hormozi: the message is written but the offer inside it is weak

precedence_note: When multiple experts match, pick the most concrete/actionable one first (a message to send beats a strategy reflection). Godin is the fallback for weekly and for anything abstract.
